description: This file contains test classes and mock implementations for testing eviction strategies, cache adapters, and related components in a ServiceBus and EventHub streaming context. It defines classes such as EventHubQueueCacheForTesting, EHEvictionStrategyForTesting, MockEventHubCacheAdaptor, CachePressureInjectionMonitor, and PurgeDecisionInjectionPredicate, focusing on testing internal behaviors.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCacheForTesting
classes.description: A test subclass of EventHubQueueCache providing access to cache item count.

classes.name: EHEvictionStrategyForTesting
classes.description: A test subclass of ChronologicalEvictionStrategy exposing in-use buffers.

classes.name: MockEventHubCacheAdaptor
classes.description: A mock adapter for EventHub data, generating stream positions with sequence tokens.

classes.name: CachePressureInjectionMonitor
classes.description: A monitor class to simulate cache pressure conditions for testing.

classes.name: PurgeDecisionInjectionPredicate
classes.description: A predicate class to control purge decision during tests.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCacheForTesting.ItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the cache.

methods.name: EHEvictionStrategyForTesting.InUseBuffers
methods.description: Provides access to the in-use buffers for testing.

methods.name: MockEventHubCacheAdaptor.GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Returns a stream position with a mock sequence token.

methods.name: CachePressureInjectionMonitor.RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Stub method to simulate recording cache pressure.

methods.name: CachePressureInjectionMonitor.IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Returns whether the cache is under pressure.

methods.name: PurgeDecisionInjectionPredicate.ShouldPurgeFromTime
methods.description: Decides whether to purge based on injected boolean.
